referenceSources.description:
A vibrant red 1983 Fiat Ritmo 130 TC Abarth stands on a damp country road next to a freshly plowed field. The compact hatchback’s black plastic bumpers, rear spoiler, and flared arches highlight its performance-oriented styling. Alloy wheels and Abarth badges on the rear tailgate and side panels underscore its racing heritage.

This photograph is sourced from Car and Classic’s Spanish auction page, where the car is listed for a seven-day bidding event. The overcast sky and wet pavement convey a cool, rural setting, while the car’s well-preserved exterior suggests careful ownership and classic appeal.
